text:
Anya Patel: Quick pre-oncall handoff — I go offline at 18:00 UTC. Before Samir takes over, please confirm these prep items (reply with OK or blockers):
1) Runbook access (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall)
2) Pager membership & test alert
3) VPN cert renewed and canconnect from home
4) CI deploy token present on the runner hosts
5) SSH keys/cached credentials for prod API boxes
6) Observability dashboards pinned (latency/cost/errors)
I can help for the next 10m.

Samir Chen: I can take. Runbook and dashboards ✅. CI tokens look present on the primary runner.
VPN cert — I saw an email about expiry for `vpn-client` last week, need to confirm renewal.
I don't have prod SSH keys cached on my laptop yet. Can someone confirm prod key is in Vault?

Miguel Ortega: I rotated pager creds yesterday and added you to group `oncall-eng` (Samir). You should be able to trigger a test alert.
Run this to test the pager webhook locally if needed:```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"alert":"pre-oncall-test","user":"samir"}' https://pager.redwood.internal/test-alert
```
Also prod SSH key is stored at `secret://vault/ssh/oncall/prod_key` and the CI runner has read access. If you need a local copy, I'll push it to your 1Password.

Samir Chen: Thanks Miguel — running the pager test now.
oncall-bot: Pager test received at 2026-03-17T17:50:10Z for user samir — escalation path verified.

Samir Chen: Pager test came through :white_check_mark: I can SSH to one prod API box after pulling the key from Vault. VPN test failing from my home network though — `tcp connect timeout` when hitting the VPN gateway.

Miguel Ortega: Hm, ISP-level NAT sometimes blocks UDP for our client. Quick workaround: try `vpn-client --mode=tcp` or connect via mobile hotspot. I'll open a quick support ticket with infra if you can't connect in 5m.

Anya Patel: If VPN still fails, please document the repro steps in the runbook under "pre-oncall connectivity" and add a link to the ticket. Otherwise I'm good to hand off.

Samir Chen: I'll update the runbook and ping here with the ticket number. Taking over now — thanks Anya! :thumbsup:
